sloka: जाबालेस्तु वच: श्रुत्वा राम: सत्यात्मनां वर: ।उवाच परया भक्त्या स्वबुद्ध्या चाविपन्नया ॥ २.१०९.१॥
transliteration: jābālestu vaca: śrutvā rāma: satyātmanāṁ vara: ।uvāca parayā bhaktyā svabuddhyā cāvipannayā ॥ 2.109.1॥

translations.english: Hearing Jabali's words, Rama, the foremost among the truthful, gave a rejoinder, exercising his own judgment and firm conviction with due respect (to Jabali).
